Warehouse.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes a new instance by setting up two empty dictionaries, inventory and orders, to serve as the backing stores for product and order data respectively." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize self.inventory as an empty dictionary intended to map product IDs to Product objects RESULT self.inventory]
            [COMMAND Initialize self.orders as an empty dictionary intended to map order IDs to Order objects RESULT self.orders]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Warehouse.add_product:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Adds a new product to the inventory with name and quantity if it does not already exist, or increments the existing product's quantity if it does." AddProduct]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> product_id </REF>: string "Unique identifier for the product to add or restock"
        <REF> name </REF>: string "Display name of the product, used only when creating a new inventory entry"
        <REF> quantity </REF>: integer "Number of units to add; initializes stock for new products or increments stock for existing ones"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether product_id is absent from self.inventory RESULT product_exists_check]
            [COMMAND If product_id is not in self.inventory, create a new entry in self.inventory keyed by product_id with a dictionary containing 'name' set to name and 'quantity' set to quantity RESULT new_inventory_entry]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: product_id already exists as a key in self.inventory]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Retrieve the existing inventory record for product_id and increment its 'quantity' field by the supplied quantity, leaving the 'name' field unchanged RESULT updated_quantity]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Warehouse.update_product_quantity:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Increments the quantity of an existing product in the inventory by a given amount, silently skipping the update if the product ID is not found." update_product_quantity]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> product_id </REF>: any (hashable) "The key identifying the product to update within the inventory dictionary"
        <REF> quantity </REF>: numeric "The amount to add to the product's current quantity; may be positive or negative"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether product_id exists as a key in self.inventory RESULT membership_check_result]
            [COMMAND If product_id is present, retrieve self.inventory[product_id] and increment its 'quantity' field by the value of quantity using in-place addition RESULT updated_quantity]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: product_id is not found in self.inventory]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Skip the update entirely; no modification is made to self.inventory and no error is raised RESULT no_op]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Warehouse.get_product_quantity:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Retrieves the quantity of a product from the inventory dictionary by its ID, returning the quantity integer if the product exists or False if it does not." GetProductQuantity]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> product_id </REF>: any "The key used to look up the product in the inventory dictionary"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> quantity </REF>: int | bool "The quantity value from inventory[product_id]['quantity'] if the product exists, or False if the product_id is not found in the inventory"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether product_id exists as a key in self.inventory using a membership test RESULT key_exists]
            [COMMAND If key_exists is True, access self.inventory[product_id] and retrieve the nested 'quantity' field, then return it immediately as the method result RESULT quantity_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: product_id is not found as a key in self.inventory]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return the boolean literal False immediately as a sentinel value indicating the product is absent RESULT false_sentinel]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Warehouse.create_order:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Checks whether sufficient product stock is available and, if so, decrements inventory by the requested quantity and records the order as shipped; returns False immediately if stock is insufficient." create_order]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> order_id </REF>: any "Unique identifier for the new order record"
        <REF> product_id </REF>: any "Identifier of the product being ordered"
        <REF> quantity </REF>: numeric "Number of units requested; must be less than or equal to available stock for the order to proceed"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean or None "Returns False when stock is insufficient; implicitly returns None on the success path because the true branch contains no explicit return statement"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call get_product_quantity with product_id and compare the result to quantity using an inclusive lower-bound check (>=); if available stock is at least quantity, proceed to the true branch, otherwise proceed to the false branch RESULT stock_check_result]
            [COMMAND Call update_product_quantity with product_id and a delta of negative quantity to decrement available inventory by exactly the requested amount RESULT inventory_updated]
            [COMMAND Write a new entry to the orders dictionary keyed by order_id containing the fields product_id, quantity, and status hard-coded to the string 'Shipped' RESULT order_recorded]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Available stock returned by get_product_quantity is strictly less than quantity (stock check fails)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return the boolean value False immediately without modifying inventory or writing any order record RESULT early_return_false]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Warehouse.change_order_status:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Updates the status field of an existing order identified by order_id, returning False if the order does not exist." change_order_status]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> order_id </REF>: any "The key used to look up the target order in the orders dictionary"
        <REF> status </REF>: any "The new status value to assign to the order"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool or None "Returns False if order_id is not found; implicitly returns None on successful update"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether order_id exists as a key in self.orders RESULT order_exists]
            [COMMAND If order_exists is True, set self.orders[order_id]['status'] to the value of status and allow the method to return implicitly with None RESULT update_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: order_id is not found as a key in self.orders]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False immediately as a sentinel value indicating the order was not found; no mutation is performed RESULT false_sentinel]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Warehouse.track_order:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Looks up an order by ID in the internal orders dictionary and returns its status string if found, or False if the order does not exist." track_order]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> order_id </REF>: any "The identifier of the order to look up, used as a key in the orders dictionary"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: str | bool "The status value associated with the order if found; the boolean False if the order_id is not present in the orders dictionary"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether order_id exists as a key in self.orders using a membership test RESULT order_exists]
            [COMMAND If order_exists is True, retrieve self.orders[order_id]['status'] and return it immediately, ending execution RESULT status_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: order_id is not found in self.orders (membership test evaluates to False)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return the boolean literal False as a not-found sentinel, ending execution immediately RESULT not_found_sentinel]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
